description.value: Enhanced Item. A blood-red talisman shaped by an ancient alchemical rite, its surface etched with Sith runes that writhe faintly when worn. While attuned, you gain a +2 bonus to the save DC of your dark side Force powers, but at the end of each long rest you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion as the amulet feeds on your resolve.
